```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

```{r}
df_unedited <- read.csv(here("Holden", "HOLDEN - PROPERTIES HEATING DETAILS.csv"), sep = "\t", header=TRUE)
```

```{r}
df_filter <- df_unedited %>%
  select(Use.code, Fuel.Description, Living.Area, Stories) %>%
  rename(USECODE = Use.code, FUELTYPE = Fuel.Description, AREASQ = Living.Area, STORYHEIGHT = Stories) %>%
  mutate(USECODE = substr(USECODE, 1, 3))
```

```{r}
write.csv(df_filter, file = "Holden_Final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
